title: Calendar Metric0 High Value Outliers
dataSources: Renewal calendar events (`calendar:event`), Rocket Money subscriptions (`rocketmoney:subscription`), Stripe invoices (`stripe:invoice`), and Google Workspace licenses (`googleworkspace:license`).
app: Renewal calendar exports, Rocket Money subscriptions, Stripe invoice history, and Google Workspace license data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=calendar:metric0 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in calendar metric0 events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme calendar metric0 records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It lays out the unusually high or low value moments in your calendar metric0 history.
